verdict.rationale: Firecrawl explicitly claims industry-leading coverage of JS-heavy pages via managed browser sessions, and supports interactive scraping (click, fill forms, extract dynamic content) plus rendering to markdown/HTML/JSON. Community discussion questions proxy robustness but does not concretely contradict JS-rendering capability itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark confirming JS rendering fidelity, more detail on rendering engine (Puppeteer vs Playwright) reliability.
